game: Call of Duty®: Black Ops III

earned.name: Can't Hide
earned.detail: In Campaign, kill an enemy through a wall or obstruction.

earned.name: Deadly Specialist
earned.detail: Get a Specialist-based medal that requires 3 or more rapid kills while using any Specialist Weapon.

earned.name: Welcome to the Club
earned.detail: Reach Sergeant (Level 10) in Multiplayer while playing online.

earned.name: Foe To Friend
earned.detail: Use an enemy combat robot to kill 10 enemies.

earned.name: Doing Camo Right
earned.detail: In Campaign, unlock all camos for any weapon.

earned.name: Hold Still!
earned.detail: Kill 6 enemies affected by one Blinding Swarm or Firefly Swarm.

earned.name: Silverback In Black
earned.detail: Hack the Data Vault and brace yourself for Cyber's Avengening in Dead Ops Arcade 2.

earned.name: Lock, Stock, And Then Some
earned.detail: In Campaign, unlock all attachments for any weapon.

earned.name: Decimator
earned.detail: In Campaign, kill 10 enemies in under 3 seconds.

earned.name: Another Side of the Story
earned.detail: Complete the Campaign on any difficulty.

earned.name: The Beginning of the End
earned.detail: In Shadows of Evil, complete all Rituals.

earned.name: From the Shadows
earned.detail: In Shadows of Evil, spot the Shadowman fives times in one game.

earned.name: Tactical Specialist
earned.detail: Get 5 Medals based on a Specialist Ability in a single game.

earned.name: Battle Tested
earned.detail: Reach Commander (Level 55) in Multiplayer while playing online.

earned.name: Disavowed
earned.detail: Complete Black Ops on Hardened, Veteran, or Realistic.

earned.name: A Second Chance
earned.detail: Complete New World on Hardened, Veteran, or Realistic.

earned.name: Pack-A-Punch-ectomy
earned.detail: In Revelations, recover the Pack-a-Punch machine from its abductor.

earned.name: Parasite-Seeing
earned.detail: In Shadows of Evil, kill 5 Parasites while riding on the train.

earned.name: I said we’re CLOSED!
earned.detail: In Nacht Der Untoten, do not let any zombies enter the building during the first 3 rounds.

earned.name: That’s a lot of Jigawatts!
earned.detail: In Der Eisendrache, electrocute 121 zombies.

earned.name: Death From Above
earned.detail: In Der Eisendrache, kill a zombie while being flung by a Wundersphere.
